title: CLCON/369/2017 of Hanuman Singh Vs Vilas S. Burde

paras.text:
CLCON No.369 of 2017
U.C. Dhyani, J.
Mr. Manish Lohani, Advocate holding
brief of Mr. Amish Tewari, Advocate for the
petitioner.
It is the submission of leaned counsel
for the petitioner that there is willful
disobedience of Courtís order dated
30.3.2017, passed in WPSS No.2291 of
2016, Hanuman Singh vs. Union of India &
others.
It is also the submission of learned
counsel for the petitioner that the casual
approach on the part of respondent should
not be tolerated and strict action should be
initiated against the alleged contemnor.
One of the objectives of contempt
jurisdiction is to ensure compliance of
Courtís order and, therefore, instead of
issuing notice to the respondent
/contemnor, this Court reiterates the order
dated 30.3.2017 and directs the respondent
to consider the case of the petitioner for
appointment to the post of Constable (G.D.)
in CAPFís as per his merit, within further
period of six weeks of presentation of
certified copy of this order, failing which
contempt proceedings may be initiated
against him.
Petitioner is directed to place a copy
of this order, as also the order dated
30.3.2017 to remind the respondent that a
duty is cast upon him to do something,
which has not been done.
With the direction as above, the
contempt petition stands disposed of.
